title: Hire Car Commandered By Armed Men O. O. L.

page_data.en:
S. B. Special Branch

Hire car commandeered by armed men O.C.I.

D.C.I. Gibson.

Sir,

At 12.35 p.m. 19-8-40 Tau Noong Sa(周同士),
accountant, and Li Ah Ling(李阿林), chauffeur, permit
No.9007, both employed at the E Tui Garage, 168 Hennessy
Road, came to the Station and reported a hire car S.M.C.
Lic.No.17711, having been commandeered by armed men in
Chep.

Enquiries by C.I.S.196 and D.C.I. Gibson.

It was ascertained that at 8.45 a.m. 19-8-40 two
male Chinese visited the E Tui Garage and stated they
wished to engage a car to proceed to Paechan Road, Chapel.
Hire car, Lic.No.17711, driven by the chauffeur, Li Ah Ling,
was supplied and the two men were driven to Paechan Road
near Jukong Road where the car was stopped.

One of the passengers alighted, entered a building
(unknown to the chauffeur) and returned a few minutes
later with two companions who also entered the car.

According to the chauffeur, under instructions
from the passengers, he then drove the car north along
Paoshan Road and after about five minutes the car
was stopped outside a partly demolished building.

The chauffeur then observed that the four
passengers were armed with pistols and they informed
him that they wished to "commandeer" the car.

One of the men then compelled the chauffeur to
enter the partly destroyed house where he, the chauffeur
was detained under the guard of the armed men for
about two hours.

（印：SPECIAL POLICE REGISTRY 317 19-8-40. 22 / 8 / 40）

INDEXED BY
(S.B.) REGISTRY
DATE 22/ 8/ 40
page_data.zh:
S. B. 特别处

武装人员征用出租车 O.C.I.

副督察长吉布森（Gibson）。

先生，

1940年8月19日下午12时35分，周同士（Tau Noong Sa），会计师，与李阿林（Li Ah Ling），司机，许可证号9007，二人均受雇于轩尼诗路168号E Tui车行，来到警局报案，称一辆公共租界工部局牌照号为17711的出租车在闸北（Chep）被武装人员征用。

刑事调查科196号警员及副督察长吉布森进行调查。

经查实，1940年8月19日上午8时45分，两名中国男子前往E Tui车行，表示希望租用一辆汽车前往闸北的百昌路（Paechan Road）。车行提供了牌照号为17711的出租车，由司机李阿林驾驶，将这两名男子载至靠近菊康路（Jukong Road）的百昌路处，车辆随后停下。

其中一名乘客下车，进入一栋建筑（司机不知其详情），几分钟后带着两名同伴返回，这两人也进入了车内。

据司机称，按照乘客的指示，他随后沿宝山路向北行驶，约五分钟后，车辆在一栋部分拆除的建筑外停下。

司机随即观察到这四名乘客均持有手枪，他们告知司机想要“征用”该车。

其中一人随后强迫司机进入那栋部分损毁的房屋，司机在武装人员的看守下被拘禁了约两小时。

（印：特别警察登记处 317 1940年8月19日. 1940年8月22日）

索引编制者
(S.B.) 登记处
日期 1940年8月22日

page_data.en:
cont'd.

At the end of that period the chauffeur was told
he could leave and the armed men decamped north along
the roadway.

The chauffeur on leaving the building found
that the hire car had been taken away. He then
reported to the S.C.G.P.B. Authorities.

After having made a report to the O.O.L.
Authorities the chauffeur returned to the E Tai
Garage at 12.20 p.m.

The chauffeur states that he does not know
the house where he was detained, that he had never
seen any of the four armed men previously, and that
he is unaware for what purpose the car was taken away.

The chauffeur has been employed over eighteen
months at the E Tai Garage and according to the
accountant is a reliable employee.

Message circulated regarding stolen car.
Description of four armed men:-

(1) Age abt.35,ht.abt.5'6",slim build, pale
long face, long hair brushed back, wearing
foreign style clothing(black jacket and
white trousers). Shanghai dialect.
(2) Age abt.30,ht.abt.5'4",slim build, yellow
round face, long hair brushed back, wearing
white shirt and brown cloth trousers.
Shanghai dialect.
(3) Age abt.30, ht.abt.5'3", round face, wearing
spectacles, straw hat, blue cloth jacket and
pants. Shanghai dialect.
(4) Age abt.40,ht.abt.5'4", long face, wearing
black long gown. Shanghai dialect.

D.D.G."A" H/Q.

page_data.zh:
续前。

在此期间结束时，司机被告知可以离开，武装人员则沿道路向北逃窜。

司机离开该建筑后发现，出租车已被开走。他随后向上海公共租界工部局警务处当局报告。

在向O.O.L.当局报案后，司机于下午12时20分返回E Tai车行。

司机表示，他不知道自己被拘禁的那栋房子，以前从未见过这四名武装人员中的任何一人，也不清楚车辆被开走的用途。

该司机在E Tai车行受雇已超过十八个月，据会计师称，他是一名可靠的雇员。

已发布关于被盗车辆的消息。
四名武装人员的体貌特征如下：-

(1) 年龄约35岁，身高约5英尺6英寸，身材瘦削，面色苍白，长脸，长发向后梳理，穿着西式服装（黑色夹克和白色长裤）。讲上海话。
(2) 年龄约30岁，身高约5英尺4英寸，身材瘦削，黄圆脸，长发向后梳理，穿着白衬衫和棕色布裤。讲上海话。
(3) 年龄约30岁，身高约5英尺3英寸，圆脸，戴眼镜，戴草帽，穿蓝色布夹克和裤子。讲上海话。
(4) 年龄约40岁，身高约5英尺4英寸，长脸，穿黑色长袍。讲上海话。

“A”区总部 副总监助理。

抄送：-
各区分局局长 - “A”区行动主管。
特别处（直接送达）。
交通科（同上）。

Leura
19-8-40.

(2)
Hire car commandeered by armed men J.C.T.

D.C.I. Gibson.

Sir,
At 3.30 p.m. 19-8-40 a telephone message was received from Dubbling Toll Station reporting that the missing car, Lic.No.17711, had been located on Seymour Road near No. 175.
The Finger Print Bureau was informed and subsequently the car was examined for finger prints prior to being removed to Leura Station.
The car was recovered on Seymour Road North of Yetholme Road. It was parked on the near side facing North.
Enquiries made in that vicinity failed to locate any witness who had observed the car being left at that point.

For D.C.I. Gibson
m.s

Sgt. Det. i/c

D.D.C.U. "A" Divn

杂项 557/40.
Leura
1940年8月19日.

(2)
武装人员征用出租车 J.C.T.

副督察长吉布森。

先生，
1940年8月19日下午3时30分，接到Dubbling收费站的电话消息，报告称失踪车辆，牌照号17711，已在西摩路（Seymour Road）近175号处被发现。
指纹局已获通知，随后在将车辆移至Leura警局之前，对该车进行了指纹检查。
该车在耶索姆路（Yetholme Road）以北的西摩路上被寻回。车辆停在路边，车头朝北。
在该附近进行的调查未能找到任何目击者观察到车辆被留在此处。

代表副督察长吉布森
m.s

警长 侦探负责人

page_data.en:
Lee Ah Tauk(李阿林) Age 36.
Tungchow. C.J.P. 196.
Leung Tn. 19-8-40. translated Clerk Koo Ting I

I am M/chauffeur in the employ of the B Tai Garage, 188
Hoopoh Road, residing 148 Tsu An Fang off Edinburgh Road.
At 8.45 a.m. 19-8-40 two male Chinese came to the
Motor
garage stating that they wanted a/car to take them to Paoshan
Road, Chapel. A car Lic.No. 17711 driven by me was supplied.
After they entered the car, I then drove away. On Paoshan
Road near Jukong Road I was told to stop the car. I did as
ordered. One of the two passengers alighted from the car
and returned about 15 minutes later with another two male
Chinese who also entered the car. At that moment I observed
that all 4 in number, were armed with pistols. Under
instructions of the passengers I then drove along Paoshan
Road in a northerly direction. After about 5 minutes I was
told to stop the car outside a partly demolished house. All
alighted from the car, one of whom armed with a pistol
compelled me to the 3rd floor of the building. At the same
time the other three passengers drove the car away. I was then
detained until 11.40 a.m. even date when the
man who guarded me led me to an open yard nearby and told me
that I could go. I then proceeded to the Paoshan Road Police
and reported the occurrences. After that I returned to the
garage. I then together with the accountant reported the
affair to this Station.

Signed and cross marked.
page_data.zh:
李阿林（Lee Ah Tauk） 年龄36岁。
通州。中央捕房 196号。
卢家嘴站 1940年8月19日. 翻译员 顾廷一（Koo Ting I）

我是受雇于霍普路（Hoopoh Road）188号B Tai车行的机动车司机，居住在爱丁堡路附近的祖安坊148号。
1940年8月19日上午8时45分，两名中国男子来到汽车车行，声称想要租一辆车送他们去闸北的宝山路。车行提供了一辆由我驾驶的牌照号为17711的汽车。
他们上车后，我便驾车离开。在宝山路靠近菊康路处，我被告知停车。我照办了。两名乘客中的一人下车，约15分钟后带着另外两名中国男子返回，这两人也上了车。当时我观察到，这四人均持有手枪。按照乘客的指示，我随后沿宝山路向北行驶。约5分钟后，我被告知在一栋部分拆除的房屋外停车。所有人下车，其中一名持手枪的人强迫我进入该建筑的三楼。与此同时，其他三名乘客将车开走。我被拘禁直至当天上午11时40分，当时看守我的人将我带到附近的一个露天院子，告诉我可以走了。我随后前往宝山路警察局报告了此事。之后我返回车行。随后我与会计师一起向本局报告了此事。

签名并画押。

page_data.en:
Tecu Dong Sz(周同士) age 28.
Ningpo. C.D.' .196.
Louza Stn 19-8-40. translated Clerk Koo Ting I

I am accountant employed at the E Tai Garage 188
Hoopoi Road, residing at No.33 Sz Ai Li off Rue Lafayette P.C.
Chinese
At about 8.45 a.m. 19-8-40 two male/dressed in foreign
clothing visited our garage stating that they wished to
engage a motor car to proceed to Fanchi Road, Chapel.
A motor car lic.No.17711 driven by the chauffeur Lee Ah Ling
was supplied.

At about 12.20 p.m. same date, a telephone message
was received at the garage from the chauffeur reporting that
said
the/car had been taken away on Haonan by four armed men.
As soon as the chauffeur returned, I together with the
chauffeur reported the occurrence to this Station.

Signed and cross marked.
page_data.zh:
周同士（Tecu Dong Sz） 年龄28岁。
宁波。中央捕房 196号。
老闸捕房 1940年8月19日. 翻译员 顾廷一（Koo Ting I）

我是受雇于霍普路（Hoopoi Road）188号E Tai车行的会计师，居住在法租界辣斐德路（Rue Lafayette）附近的斯爱里33号。
1940年8月19日上午8时45分左右，两名身穿西式服装的中国男子来到我们车行，表示希望租用一辆汽车前往闸北的范氏路（Fanchi Road）。
车行提供了一辆由司机李阿林驾驶的牌照号为17711的汽车。

同日中午12时20分左右，车行接到司机的电话消息，报告称该车在河南路（Haonan）被四名武装人员劫走。
司机一回来，我便与司机一起向本局报告了此事。

签名并画押。
